dict.string: 選択中の画像をImageOptimで圧縮する / Optimize images with ImageOptim
選択中の項目か開いているフォルダをImageOptimで圧縮 / Optimize selected items or the open folder

use framework "Foundation" use scripting additions
on t(ja, en) set lang to system attribute "language" if lang is "ja" then return ja if lang is "en" then return en set preferred to (current application's NSLocale's preferredLanguages()'s firstObject()) as text if preferred is "ja" or preferred starts with "ja-" then return ja return en end t
on targetPaths() set found to {} set pathFinder to "Path Finder" tell application "System Events" to set frontApp to name of first process whose frontmost is true if frontApp is pathFinder then tell application pathFinder try set sel to (get «property slcT») on error errMsg number errNum if errNum is -1743 then error errMsg number errNum set sel to {} end try if sel is missing value then set sel to {} repeat with anItem in sel set end of found to «property pthP» of anItem end repeat if found is {} then try set end of found to «property pthP» of «property tarG» of «class fwiD» 1 end try end if end tell else if frontApp is "Finder" then tell application "Finder" repeat with anItem in (get selection) set end of found to POSIX path of (anItem as alias) end repeat if found is {} then try set end of found to POSIX path of (target of front Finder window as alias) end try end if end tell end if return found end targetPaths
on run argv try set targets to my targetPaths() on error errMsg number errNum if errNum is -1743 then return my t("オートメーションの許可が必要です。システム設定 > プライバシーとセキュリティ > オートメーション で Alfred に Finder・Path Finder・System Events の制御を許可してください。", "Automation access is required. Allow Alfred to control Finder, Path Finder and System Events in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation.") return my t("選択項目を取得できませんでした: ", "Could not get the selection: ") & errMsg end try if targets is {} then return my t("FinderまたはPath Finderで画像を選択するか、フォルダを開いてください", "Select images or open a folder in Finder or Path Finder") set command to "open -a ImageOptim" repeat with targetPath in targets set command to command & " " & quoted form of (targetPath as text) end repeat try do shell script command on error errMsg return my t("ImageOptimで開けませんでした: ", "Could not open in ImageOptim: ") & errMsg end try end run

FinderまたはPath Finderで選択中の項目をImageOptimに渡します。選択がなければ開いているフォルダを渡します。 Sends the items selected in Finder or Path Finder to ImageOptim, or the open folder if nothing is selected.
Usage: <keyword> (default keyword: io)
Workflowが表示する文言の言語。 / Language of the text shown by the workflow.
Alfredで入力するキーワード。 / The keyword typed in Alfred.
